messages.subject: RKWard 0.8.2 is released!
messages.body_plain:
Hi!

RKWard 0.8.2 is officially available for download, today. You can read
up on the details, and pick the correct download for your platform on
https://rkward.kde.org, as usual. Thanks to all testers and
contributors!

(You may note that the official release day was yesterday, but some of
the binary builds took longer than expected.)

Regards
Thomas

messages.subject: RKWard 0.8.2 not working on a Windows 10 VM
messages.subject_clean: RKWard 0.8.2 not working on a Windows 10 VM
messages.body_plain:
I just tried out to install RKWard 0.8.2, on a Windows 10 VM.
Every thing went well through the installation process,
but when I tried to run it I kept receiving the message that the file
"kdesigleapplicaition-qt6.dll" was missing, that reinstalling it would
solve the problem, but it did not. I even redownloaded the file and even
tried out the daily build with no success.
I ended up reinstalling the 0.8.1 version which was a success, it ran
smoothly.
Any thoughts?
Regards

Alfonso

messages.subject: rk.dplyr
messages.body_plain:
Here is another plug-in,

https://github.com/AlfCano/rk.dplyr

a user-friendly graphical interface for the powerful data combination and
manipulation functions in the R package dplyr. It simplifies common data
wrangling tasks by providing clear dialogs for four categories of
operations, each requiring two data frames as input: Combine by
Binding, Mutating Joins, Filtering Joins, Set Operations.

Regards
Alfonso

PD: I just have tried out the rkward at kde.org, but I think it is not active
yet.
